description_en: Adds a commit status record to a specified commit
description_zh: 给指定的Commit添加一条提交状态记录
kebab_example: aliyun devops create-commit-status --organization-id 5ebbc0228123212b59xxxxx --repository-identity 2080972 --sha e0c1a1299a2656bfc155650bbd2df5e628fa1f4c --state success --api-version 2021-06-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCommitStatus

parameters.help_en: The enterprise identifier, also known as the enterprise ID. It is a string and can be obtained from the Yunxiao URL, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/[OrganizationId]
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: The personal access token. This field is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey ID and AccessKey secret or Security Token Service (STS) temporary authorization
parameters.help_zh:
个人访问令牌。
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
parameters.name: access_token

parameters.help_en: The ID or full path of the code repository
parameters.name: repository_identity

parameters.help_en: The commit ID, which is the commit SHA
parameters.name: sha

parameters.help_en:
The string identifier used to distinguish writes from different systems. It is displayed as a title in the corresponding page UI. The default value is default. The length cannot exceed 50 characters, and it is case-insensitive.

This parameter is crucial for configuring checkpoints and merge request integration. Do not modify it at will unless you are testing or debugging
parameters.help_zh:
用于区分不同系统写入的字符串标识，会以标题的作用在相应的页面UI处进行展示，默认为default，长度不超过50，且英文大小写不敏感

该参数在设置卡点和合并请求联动中非常重要，若非测试调试，切勿随意设置
parameters.name: context

parameters.help_en: The brief description of the commit status. It cannot exceed 3,000 characters
parameters.help_zh: 提交状态的简要描述，且不能超过3000个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The status to be written. Only the following four strings are allowed. Otherwise, an error is returned. Valid values:
error: Error.
failure: Failure.
pending: Running.
success: Success
parameters.help_zh:
写入状态，且仅能填入以下四个字符串，否则会返回错误。
error：异常
failure：失败
pending：运行中
success：成功
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en: The redirect URL written by the user. The code platform only provides the redirect UI. Generally, this can be set to a URL of a third-party system
parameters.help_zh: 用户自行写入的跳转链接，代码平台仅提供跳转的UI，一般可设置为三方系统的链接
parameters.name: target_url

context.description_en: The string identifier used to distinguish writes from different systems. It is displayed as a title in the corresponding page UI. The default value is default. The length cannot exceed 50 characters, and it is case-insensitive
context.description_zh: 用于区分不同系统写入的字符串标识，会以标题的作用在相应的页面UI处进行展示，默认为default，长度不超过50，且英文大小写不敏感

creator.description_en: The brief information about the user who wrote the commit status
creator.description_zh: 提交状态的写入人简要信息

aliyunPk.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID. This field is empty if the type is Bot
aliyunPk.description_zh: 阿里云账号ID，若type=Bot时，则为空

login.description_en: The username if the type is User, or the application name if the type is Bot
login.description_zh: 若type=User，则为用户名；若type=Bot，则为应用名

type.description_en:
The type of the user who wrote the status. Valid values:
User: Regular user.
Bot: Application
type.description_zh:
写入人类型
User：普通用户类型
Bot：应用类型

description.description_en: The brief description of the commit status. It cannot exceed 3,000 characters
description.description_zh: 提交状态的简要描述，且不能超过3000个字符

id.description_en: The ID. This ID has no actual business meaning

sha.description_en: The commit ID, which is the commit SHA

state.description_en:
The written status. Valid values:
error: Error.
failure: Failure.
pending: Running.
success: Success
state.description_zh:
写入状态
error：异常
failure：失败
pending：运行中
success：成功

targetUrl.description_en: The redirect URL written by the user. The code platform only provides the redirect UI. Generally, this can be set to a URL of a third-party system
targetUrl.description_zh: 用户自行写入的跳转链接，代码平台仅提供跳转的UI，一般可设置为三方系统的链接

success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
